audit.purpose: Pre-task shipping identity, sole provenance ownership, and supersession-sensitive tracked surfaces for the 272 item-art consistency replacements.
audit.scopeNote: All pre-task bytes and mapping ownership were read from the resolved Git commit, never from the concurrently modified worktree.

literalOldShippingHashPins.method: git grep -n -I -F across the complete tracked tree using all distinct old SHA-256 values

constraints: Each affected asset literal-pins the pre-task acceptedSha256 and acceptedBytes.
targetSets.items keeps the affected IDs in the historical 101-item wave.
pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Keep the historical pins immutable and add an explicit supersession ledger/new accepted-art batch. Live-file validators should resolve superseded IDs to the replacement record while retaining an audit of these hashes at the pre-task commit.

tests.name: pins decodable shipping identity, dimensions, alpha, weight and unique art
tests.constraint: Directly compares every historical manifest acceptedBytes/acceptedSha256 to the live shipping file.

tests.name: owns every target exactly once in truthful generated item batches
tests.constraint: Requires each historical target to remain in one generated batch and requires the live batch references/prompt to equal the historical accepted-art manifest.

pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Teach the historical-wave checks to consult a supersession ledger: validate the archived artifact against its recorded commit and validate the live replacement against its new batch, prompt, references, and one-owner invariant.

tests.name: pins the complete accepted-art audit using the checked-in manifest and shipping assets
tests.constraint: Runs the checked-in missing-painted accepted-art manifest against live shipping assets, preserving its identity/hash contract.

pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Run historical accepted-art manifests in archival mode for superseded IDs and run the replacement batch manifest against live shipping paths.

tests.name: F4) records every final-wave item once as project-generated art
tests.constraint: Reads the historical 101-item target set and requires every affected ID to remain absent from ordinary entries and present in exactly one generated batch.

pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: The one-generated-owner assertion remains valid after transfer to the replacement batch; source the live ownership expectation from the supersession ledger so the historical wave does not imply current-batch ownership.

constraints: Each affected weapon literal-pins the pre-task acceptedSha256 and acceptedBytes.
targetSets.weaponItems identifies both as members of the historical 119-weapon completion wave.
pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Keep the historical pins and 119-weapon accomplishment record immutable; add explicit supersededBy metadata in a separate ledger/new batch rather than rewriting history.

constraints: The record literal-pins the pre-task shipping SHA-256 for each affected weapon.
The completion accepted-art manifest separately pins this evidence document as a whole.
pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Keep this historical generation record immutable and create a new replacement generation record; link old and new identities through the supersession ledger.

constraints: The record literal-pins the pre-task shipping SHA-256 for each affected weapon.
The completion accepted-art manifest separately pins this evidence document as a whole.
pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Keep this historical generation record immutable and create a new replacement generation record; link old and new identities through the supersession ledger.

tests.name: is a valid accepted-art audit manifest with exact shipping pins
tests.constraint: Directly compares every accepted-art asset byte/hash pin to its live shipping path.

tests.name: pins the complete audited inventory against live registries
tests.constraint: Keeps the two IDs in the historical 119-weapon inventory; this is compatible with supersession if historical scope is separated from live ownership.

pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Resolve superseded historical assets against the archived commit/ledger and validate the new live files under the replacement batch; preserve the 119-ID historical scope.

tests.name: records the exact authored weapon registry under one generated-art owner
tests.constraint: Requires all 119 weapons to live in one batch, requires that batchId to equal placeholder-art-completion-weapons-2026-08-09, and requires its itemIds to equal the full weapon registry.

pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Replace the single-historical-batch assertion with exactly-one-current-owner across generated batches; require the replacement batch for superseded weapons and retain the old batch record only for unsuperseded historical members.

constraints: The v0.36 weapon row says the exact 119 base-weapon IDs are in placeholder-art-completion-weapons-2026-08-09.
pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Describe the row as the historical 119-weapon creation wave and add a replacement-wave credit/lineage pointer for superseded live paintings.

constraints: Each affected ID has one pre-task generated-batch owner whose exact batch index and batchId are recorded per audit record.
pinAndMembershipRequirements.recommendation: Move every replacement ID out of its prior owner and into the new replacement batch atomically; retain historical ownership in the supersession audit/accepted-art records, never as a second live mapping owner.

trackedSupersessionSurfaces.recommendation: Use an explicit tracked supersession ledger keyed by item ID with old commit/hash/owner and new batch/hash/owner. Historical accepted-art manifests stay immutable; live tests route superseded IDs to the new batch while independently asserting exactly one current mapping owner.
